clue.text: Tax before May on religious centre

indicators.note: before places the tax ahead of the other piece in the answer

parts.note: VAT is value added tax, the British sales tax
may in the sense of being able to is I CAN

explanation.surface: A levy imposed ahead of a spring month on some holy place.
explanation.walkthrough: May looks like the month but is the verb of permission or ability, read as I CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: The Vatican in Rome is the seat of the Pope and headquarters of the Catholic Church.

clue.text: Trying to reach this result

parts.note: trying here is a court trying a case: the result a trial reaches is the jury's decision

explanation.surface: Someone striving towards a particular outcome.
explanation.definitionFit: A jury's finding at the end of a trial is the outcome of the court's trying of the case.

clue.text: Silently, cattily, waywardly

indicators.note: waywardly means in an unruly, erratic way, so the letters before it go astray into a new order

explanation.surface: Behaving quietly but spitefully and unpredictably.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something tacitly is doing it without words, implied rather than stated.

clue.text: Many a fine filament on the seat

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a crossword stand-in for many
a hair is a very fine strand or filament

explanation.surface: A thread lying on a piece of furniture.
explanation.definitionFit: A chair is a single seat with a back.

clue.text: One who counts the top part only

definitions.meaning: a person who counts or enumerates things
in a fraction, the figure written above the line

explanation.definitionFit: A counter of things, and the upper figure of a fraction above the divisor.

clue.text: Brian was moved during TV broadcast that was thrilling

indicators.note: during means the moved letters sit within the time of the other piece, so they go inside it
broadcast as scattered widely, so the two letters of the television abbreviation are rearranged
moved signals the man's name has its letters shifted into a new order

explanation.surface: A man called Brian was touched by something he saw on a television programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' turns TV into VT, and 'was moved' turns BRIAN into IBRAN, which goes 'during' VT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something vibrant is full of energy and life, exciting.

clue.text: Spring found under the bank

definitions.meaning: to spring is to leap, as over a horse in a gym
a strongroom in a bank's basement

explanation.definitionFit: To vault is to leap; and a vault is the secure underground chamber of a bank.

clue.text: Sleeping partner?

parts.note: a sleeping partner is a silent business investor, but read literally it is someone sharing your bed, an associate

explanation.definitionFit: Literally the person you share a bed with; figuratively any associate or ally.

clue.text: A crime wave over a country

indicators.note: wave suggests the letters are tossed about like water, giving a new order

explanation.walkthrough: 'wave' is the anagram signal, not the sea; 'over' is only a link here.
explanation.definitionFit: The United States is commonly called by this name.

clue.text: Willingly departed from this life?

parts.note: willingly here means having made a will, so this describes someone who died with one in place

explanation.definitionFit: A testate person died having made a legal will.

clue.text: It could be a miracle to do this to land

indicators.note: it stands for the answer, which could be the clue word reshuffled, an arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: Turning land into farmland would be a wonder.
explanation.definitionFit: To reclaim land is to make waste or flooded ground usable, as by draining marshes or the sea.

clue.text: Uniform for nudists?

parts.note: a military term for everyday uniform, but literally it is the state of having no clothes on

explanation.definitionFit: In the army undress is ordinary, non-ceremonial uniform; it also means being naked.

clue.text: Explain another reprint, and in French

indicators.note: another version of a word is a different arrangement of the same letters

parts.note: et is the French word for and

explanation.surface: Asking for a clarification of a second printing, with French thrown in.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue as held runs 'another' and 'reprint' together; 'another' is the anagram signal, a different version of the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: To interpret something is to explain its meaning.

clue.text: Show girl with inner sex-appeal

indicators.note: with inner says the girl has the second piece placed inside her

parts.note: Eva is a girl's name
IT is a dated term for sex appeal, from the 1920s film star the It Girl

explanation.surface: A showgirl whose allure comes from within.
explanation.definitionFit: Evita is the Lloyd Webber stage musical about Eva Perón.

clue.text: Herb says licensing hours are over

indicators.note: says signals that the word is spoken, so it is heard rather than seen

parts.note: in a British pub, the landlord calls Time! when the legal drinking hours end

explanation.surface: A man named Herb announcing that the pub is closing.
explanation.walkthrough: British pubs once had legal licensing hours; at closing the landlord shouts 'Time!'
explanation.definitionFit: A small aromatic plant used for seasoning in cooking.

clue.text: Ivy possibly always on the go

parts.note: ever means always, as in ever hopeful
green is the traffic light that means go

explanation.surface: A woman named Ivy who is forever busy.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy is an example of a plant that keeps its leaves all year round.

clue.text: One drawer in the gallery might amuse one

indicators.note: in places the first pieces inside the gallery's name

parts.note: the Tate is the famous London art gallery
one is the Roman numeral I
a till is the cash drawer in a shop counter

explanation.surface: An artist at a gallery could entertain somebody.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drawer' suggests an artist at a gallery but is the cash drawer.
explanation.definitionFit: To titillate is to excite or stimulate pleasantly, close to amusing.

clue.text: Best basket is an unnecessary weight on deck

parts.note: top means best, as in top marks
a hamper is a large lidded basket, for picnics

explanation.surface: A superior wicker basket is nothing but useless clutter aboard ship.
explanation.definitionFit: On ships, top-hamper is superfluous gear and rigging aloft that adds weight.

clue.text: Not the best cheese for catching vermin

definitions.meaning: cheap, low-grade cheddar fit only for baiting rodents
a device that snaps shut on rodents

explanation.definitionFit: A spring device catching mice, and by extension the poor cheese used to bait it.

clue.text: Graduates spinning coin coming from the lodge

parts.note: MAs are Masters of Arts, graduates

indicators.note: spinning tosses the letters of the word around into another order

explanation.surface: Students flipping a coin as they leave a cabin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinning' rearranges COIN into ONIC; 'coming from the lodge' is the definition, since Freemasons meet in lodges.
explanation.definitionFit: Freemasons are organised into lodges, so anything masonic pertains to such a lodge.

clue.text: Public service's usefulness

definitions.meaning: a public service such as gas or water supply; the 's stands for is

explanation.definitionFit: A utility is a gas, power or water supply company; utility is also practical value.

clue.text: A charming lady

parts.note: charming read as casting charms or spells, rather than delightful

explanation.definitionFit: A woman practising magic, who casts charms.

clue.text: Pedro to reconstruct a missile for use in the main

definitions.text: a missile for use in the main

indicators.note: to reconstruct is to rebuild, so these letters are reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Telling a man to rebuild a weapon for naval warfare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the main' is a poetic name for the open sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-propelled underwater weapon fired from ships and submarines.

clue.text: Crazy type of metal thread?

definitions.meaning: gone wild or out of control

explanation.definitionFit: Going haywire means going out of control; baling wire for hay is its literal sense.

clue.text: Smart cheat

definitions.meaning: to smart is to feel a sharp pain

explanation.definitionFit: A sting is a sharp, burning pain, and in slang a con trick.

clue.text: Is one of its four days of publication December 25 th?

definitions.text: Is one of its four days of publication December 25 th?

parts.words: Is one of its four days of publication December 25 th?
parts.note: Christmas is one of the four English quarter days, so a journal published four times a year might come out on one

explanation.definitionFit: A quarterly magazine appears four times a year, once each quarter.

clue.text: Line of waiters

parts.note: waiters read as people who wait, not restaurant staff

explanation.definitionFit: A row of people waiting their turn.

clue.text: Times in bars

parts.note: bars as musical measures, not pubs; times are speeds of a musical piece

explanation.definitionFit: The plural of the musical speed marking, the pace at which bars of music are played.

clue.text: Simplicity of being unusually vain before summer abroad

indicators.note: before sets the anagram ahead of the next piece
unusually says the letters are arranged in an uncommon way

parts.note: ete is the French word for summer

explanation.surface: An unworldly vanity before a holiday abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: Naivety is innocence, lack of guile or sophistication.

clue.text: Old city ceremony that is in turmoil, I concluded

parts.note: pomp is splendid ceremonial display

indicators.note: turmoil turns things upside down, so the two letters of the abbreviation are flipped round

parts.note: ie is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A ceremony in an ancient city ends in chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in turmoil' flips IE to EI; with just two letters any scramble is a turnaround. 'concluded' says the final I ends the word.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman city destroyed by Vesuvius in AD 79.

clue.text: Nancy performed with energy inside and at the end-hot stuff

indicators.note: inside places the letter for energy within the rearranged name
performed as acted out, so the letters of the name are reworked

parts.note: E is the symbol for energy in physics
the same E supplied again, at the end

explanation.surface: Nancy put on a lively show, then served something spicy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'performed' turns NANCY into CAYNN; 'inside' puts E within it, and 'at the end' adds another E.
explanation.definitionFit: Cayenne pepper is a fiery spice.

clue.text: Greeting leading zoologist in the capital found underground

indicators.note: in places these pieces inside the capital city

parts.note: Rome is the capital of Italy
hi is a casual greeting

indicators.note: leading picks the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: Saying hello to a top zoologist in the Italian capital.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a description: a rootlike stem is something found underground.
explanation.definitionFit: A rhizome is a horizontal underground plant stem, like ginger root.
